name: Surabaya ISOPLUS Marathon 2026
short_description: A full-marathon event in Surabaya, Indonesia, taking place October 4, 2026, with 42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distance options.
ai_summary: The Surabaya ISOPLUS Marathon 2026 is a full-marathon event scheduled for October 4, 2026, in Surabaya, Indonesia. Runners can choose from four distances: 42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, and 5km, catering to a range of experience levels. The specific venue within Surabaya has not yet been disclosed, and registration has not yet opened.

cons: Exact venue within Surabaya has not yet been announced

research_highlights: The marathon route is designed to pass Surabaya's historic landmarks including Tugu Pahlawan, Jembatan Merah, Balai Kota, Hotel Majapahit, and Museum Siola, per the 2025 edition's course description.
Cut-off times for 2026: Full Marathon 6 hours, Half Marathon 3.5 hours, 10K 2 hours, 5K 1.5 hours, Kids Dash 30 minutes.
Flag-off times are early morning to beat the heat: Full Marathon 04:00 WIB, Half Marathon 04:30 WIB, 10K 05:30 WIB, 5K 06:15 WIB.
Race village/start-finish hub is at Balai Kota (City Hall) Surabaya, with race pack collection held separately at Mal Ciputra World on Oct 2-3, 2026.
For the 2025 edition organizers emphasized elevated medical staffing including cardiologists, anesthesiologists, ambulances and a mobile mini-ICU due to heat and endurance risks.
research_watchouts: Organizers explicitly warned 2025 participants about heat and heat-stroke risk, advising strict hydration and not overexerting in hot conditions.
This is a young event (first held in 2025), so track record and crowd-support/organizational consistency across editions is still limited.

Most available commentary so far comes from official press releases and organizer-curated testimonials rather than independent runner reviews, so course/crowd-support details beyond the official narrative are hard to verify.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at the Surabaya ISOPLUS Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The event offers four distance options for participants to choose from: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, a 10km race, and a shorter 5km race. This range allows runners of varying experience and fitness levels to select a suitable distance.
